**Game and mission**
Which of the six games, and where in it (menu, mission name, vehicle, multiplayer).

**Headset and runtime**
Headset, how it is connected (Link, Air Link, Virtual Desktop, SteamVR, other), and the OpenXR runtime that is active.

**Build**
The version shown in the launcher window title, or line 1 of `Halo_MCC_VR\HaloMCCVR.log`.

**What happened**
What you did, what you saw, and what you expected instead. One problem per report.

**Logs**
Attach `Halo_MCC_VR\HaloMCCVR.log` and `Halo_MCC_VR\HaloMCCVRLauncher.log` from the game folder. Both are plain text and contain no personal data beyond file paths.
